senses.d: The fifteenth numeral symbol of the English alphabet, called o and written in the Latin script.
The name of the Latin script letter O/o.
A zero (used in reading out numbers).
ex: It is currently two-o-five in the afternoon (2:05 PM).
The first permanent English settlement in America was in Jamestown in sixteen-o-seven (1607).
